ruleDefinitions.name: New DLL Registered Via Odbcconf.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with "REGSVR" in order to register a new DLL (equivalent to running regsvr32). Attackers abuse this to install and run malicious DLLs.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\odbcconf\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "odbcconf\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*REGSVR\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*")))
